hypothesis: W-R22 and W-R23 mask-aware classifiers detect all-four-channel zero rows. Test whether the same fixed models survive incomplete, channel-specific observation loss that is not recognized by an all-zero-row detector. Under changed observation semantics no new training or model width is permitted.
freeze: Source-birth preregistration before first-use; all dropout positions/types fixed and no access to W-R23 heldout seeds.
training: Reuse unchanged W-R22 original four models with 16 trained weights+bias and 1728 paired development examples each (seeds240..255); no retraining, new features, or capacity.

heldout.mask_application: Mask absolute tick/channel positions AFTER positive or negative order transformation so physical dropout is independent of label.

primary: Per cell and seed paired classification accuracy and observationally equivalent positive/negative pair count. PARTIAL_CHANNEL_TRANSFER if maskaware_augmented reaches >=0.80 in EVERY non-full-row masked-cell condition, >naive_augmented pooled across those conditions by >=0.05 and all both-swapped-full-row cases have exact 0.5 paired accuracy. MIXED if maskaware_augmented exceeds naive_augmented pooled by >=0.05 on partial dropout but strict criterion fails; NEGATIVE otherwise. Report bound of 50% for equivalent labeled pairs.
controls: No erasure of swap rows except the explicitly fully-unidentifiable both-swap case
No filtering of indistinguishable example pairs; both positive/negative outcomes retained
Source and prereg blobs verified, full Go regression after first original archive
No heldout adaptation, threshold retuning, extra sensor or model budget
claim_limit: Synthetic incomplete-sensor robustness only; no natural language or autonomous intelligence.
